description: The reports of a proof pack (plan task pod-30, docs/PROOF-RENDER.md): hidden characters, numbers and the rate (lib/proof/render/text.mjs), the diff stat (diffstat.mjs), the dictionary (i18n.mjs), the source, the verdict and every section (model.mjs), Markdown and its cap (md.mjs), the page and its policy (html.mjs), and chatmcp verify show --pack (lib/proof/cli/report.mjs and its wiring in args.mjs, commands.mjs, messages.mjs and schema.mjs), judged by tests/verify-proof-render.mjs.
